main_text.l: ea obsessos vis hostium & penuria urgebat: consumptisque omnibus quae mandi poterant, fames invaluerat. Ita defessis intus inedia defensoribus opidum captum incensumque. Rex, ut propheta dixerat, effosis oculis, Babyloniam translatus: Hieremias misericordia hostili carcere exemptus. Cum eum Nabuzardan princeps regius, captivum cum caeteris duceret, delata sibi optione ab eo, utrum in solo patrio deferto defolatoque subsistere, an secum abire in summis honoribus vellet, residere in patria maluit. Nabuchodonosor abducto populo, reliquis, quos belli conditio vel praedae fastidium reliquos a victoribus fecerat, Godolian ejusdem gentis praepofuit, absque ullo insigni regio, aut imperii nomine: quia praeesse paucis & calamitosis, nulla dignitas erat.

page.notes: The page number "ij" is probably "ii" with a j-form second letter; the left-margin notes are partly cut and some are uncertain ("quias. Gis.", "forte te-linqui."). The word "deferto" is a doubtful reading. The "Captivi-" and "Babylonica" notes are split across lines. The text may include several printed errors; the transcription keeps the printed spelling where legible.
